name: Hayasaka Minoru
source:
The protagonist, who teaches history.

He is quite popular with the students, especially [url=/c114412]Hotta Koumei[/url]. He plays with his students during lunch break. 

Two years ago, he was confessed to by then teacher trainee [url=/c113092]Minase Emi[/url], and so they started dating. To prevent his seniors and the students from teasing her, he hides their relationship from others. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.at-sakura.net/ntr/brand/098/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
